title: Review blocks a new project the signed-in person cannot create: it names the missing project.create org right and the fix (an org role that grants it, or an existing project) before Apply writes any folder.
verification: Source reads profile.get project_create_orgs on the selected hosted connection; a local universe, an older server or a failed read leaves Apply's own refusal. Unit and agent-shell tests cover the block; the windows-native-lab walk as a project-role-only person remains owed.
